lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਅਲਾਹ ਦੀ ਜਾਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat niraalee alaah dee jaapai gur veechaar ||
lines.translation: The worship of the Lord is unique - it is known only by reflecting upon the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥੧੪॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam hiradai vasai bhai bhagatee naam savaar ||9||14||36||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Naam, through the Lord's Fear and devotion, is embellished with the Naam. ||9||14||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: an ras mahi bholaaiaa bin naamai dukh paai ||
lines.translation: He wanders around, engrossed in other pleasures, but without the Naam, he suffers in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਜਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh na bhetio j sachee boojh bujhaai ||1||
lines.translation: He does not meet the True Guru, the Primal Being, who imparts true understanding. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man mere baavale har ras chakh saad paai ||
lines.translation: O my insane mind, drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੂੰ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: an ras laagaa too(n) phirahi birathaa janam gavaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Attached to other pleasures, you wander around, and your life wastes away uselessly. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jug mahi guramukh niramale sach naam rahahi liv laai ||
lines.translation: In this age, the Gurmukhs are pure; they remain absorbed in the love of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vin karamaa kichh paaeeai nahee kiaa kar kahiaa jaai ||2||
lines.translation: Without the destiny of good karma, nothing can be obtained; what can we say or do? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaanahi sabad marahi manahu taj vikaar ||
lines.translation: He understands his own self, and dies in the Word of the Shabad; he banishes corruption from his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur saranaaee bhaj pae bakhase bakhasanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: He hurries to the Guru's Sanctuary, and is forgiven by the Forgiving Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sukh na paaeeai naa dukh vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, peace is not obtained, and pain does not depart from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jag maaiaa mohi viaapiaa doojai bharam bhulaai ||4||
lines.translation: This world is engrossed in attachment to Maya; it has gone astray in duality and doubt. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dohaaganee pir kee saar na jaanahee kiaa kar karahi seegaar ||
lines.translation: The forsaken soul-brides do not know the value of their Husband Lord; how can they decorate themselves?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲਦੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਨ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sadaa jaladeeaa phirahi sejai ravai na bhataar ||5||
lines.translation: Night and day, they continually burn, and they do not enjoy the Bed of their Husband Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee mahal paaiaa vichahu aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: The happy soul-brides obtain the Mansion of His Presence, eradicating their self-conceit from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਸਹਿ ਲਈਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee seegaareeaa apane sahi laeeaa milaai ||6||
lines.translation: They decorate themselves with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and their Husband Lord unites them with Himself. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maranaa manahu visaariaa maaiaa mohu gubaar ||
lines.translation: He has forgotten death, in the darkness of attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਭੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mar mar ja(n)mahi bhee marahi jam dar hohi khuaar ||7||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die again and again, and are reborn; they die again, and are miserable at the Gate of Death. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap milaaian se mile gur sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: They alone are united, whom the Lord unites with Himself; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaane mukh ujale tit sachai darabaar ||8||22||15||37||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam; their faces are radiant, in that True Court. ||8||22||15||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਨਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਰੁਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch manaae pa(n)ch rusaae ||
lines.translation: When the five virtues were reconciled, and the five passions were estranged,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਵਸਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch vasaae pa(n)ch gavaae ||1||
lines.translation: I enshrined the five within myself, and cast out the other five. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: inh bidh nagar vuthaa mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: In this way, the village of my body became inhabited, O my Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: durat gaiaa gur giaan driRaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Vice departed, and the Guru's spiritual wisdom was implanted within me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach dharam kee kar deenee vaar ||
lines.translation: The fence of true Dharmic religion has been built around it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰਹੇ ਮੁਹਕਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pharahe muhakam gur giaan beechaar ||2||
lines.translation: The spiritual wisdom and reflective meditation of the Guru has become its strong gate. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam khetee beejahu bhaaee meet ||
lines.translation: So plant the seed of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O friends, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਨੀਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saudaa karahu gur sevahu neet ||3||
lines.translation: Deal only in the constant service of the Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj sukh ke sabh haat ||
lines.translation: With intuitive peace and happiness, all the shops are filled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਥਾਟ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saah vaapaaree ekai thaat ||4||
lines.translation: The Banker and the dealers dwell in the same place. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਜੀਆ ਡੰਨੁ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਜਗਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jejeeaa da(n)n ko lae na jagaat ||
lines.translation: There is no tax on non-believers, nor any fines or taxes at death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਪ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kar deenee dhur kee chhaap ||5||
lines.translation: The True Guru has set the Seal of the Primal Lord upon these goods. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਦਿ ਖੇਪ ਚਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vakhar naam lad khep chalaavahu ||
lines.translation: So load the merchandise of the Naam, and set sail with your cargo.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: lai laahaa guramukh ghar aavahu ||6||
lines.translation: Earn your profit, as Gurmukh, and you shall return to your own home. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saahu sikh vanajaare ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Banker, and His Sikhs are the traders.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: poo(n)jee naam lekhaa saach samhaare ||7||
lines.translation: Their merchandise is the Naam, and meditation on the True Lord is their account. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਵਸੈ ਇਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: so vasai it ghar jis gur pooraa sev ||
lines.translation: One who serves the True Guru dwells in this house.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: abichal nagaree naanak dev ||8||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Divine City is eternal. ||8||1||
